sync_with_picture: Cha-chings hit green cash/gold flashes (0:03.3, 0:12.6, 0:25.2); Vine booms hit toxic ex (0:09.4) and golden-toilet flex (0:18.0); paper slap hits 'FAIL' test (0:20.2); stomps match stairs (0:22.0-0:22.5); thud hits Jake collapsing (0:27.2); ghostly shimmer matches Mom fading transparent (0:30.9-0:31.9).
faces_and_mouths: 2D decals snap per beat on R6 heads (no phoneme lip-sync): Jake cycles from scheming grin to Pog shock (0:12.5), greedy tongue-out craze (0:14.6), sunglasses flex (0:17.0), rage (0:21.0), yell mouth (0:24.0), and floor panic (0:27.1); Mom shifts from scowl (0:19.1) to crying eyes (0:30.1) as she fades.
comedic_or_emotional_timing: Zero-breath escalation from ex-revenge (0:09.4 boom + 0:12.6 cha-ching) to golden-toilet greed (0:18.0 boom) sets up tonal whiplash at 0:27.2 (collapse thud) and 0:29.5 (TTS slowing to ~1.0x on 'his mom was the one who taught—').
first_3_seconds: 0:00.0 pop, urgent ~1.2x male TTS ('In this world, if you say I want a refund to someone's face, you get back—'), 0:00.7 whoosh, and wistful synthwave hook scrollers instantly.
ending: Hard-cuts mid-phrase right after 'taught—' at 0:31.9 while caption reads 'TAUGHT him EVERYTHING' and synthwave stays hot (-22.4 dB into -25.9 dB at 0:00.0), looping cleanly.
mix: Loud mid-forward master (-12.9 LUFS, LRA 1.7 LU, -0.4 dBTP) with 64.1% energy in 250 Hz-4 kHz, punchy <130 Hz Vine booms (0:09.4, 0:18.0), and bright >3.5 kHz cha-chings.
why_the_sound_works: Repeated cha-chings (0:03.3, 0:12.6, 0:25.2) build a reward cue that turns tragic on the final payout.
Breathless editing (1.7 LU LRA, zero silences) leaves no exit point across 31.9s.
Slowing TTS from ~1.2x to ~1.0x at 0:29.5 adds instant tragic weight to the twist.
Cutting mid-phrase after 'taught—' at 0:31.9 against the full caption forces replay completion.
